text: For our fathers did not possess the land [of Canaan] by their own sword, Nor did their own arm save them, But Your right hand and Your arm and the light of Your presence, Because You favored and delighted in them.
In God we have boasted all the day long, And we will praise and give thanks to Your name forever. Selah.
Because of the voice of the taunter and reviler, Because of the presence of the enemy and the avenger.
Yet You have [distressingly] crushed us in the place of jackals And covered us with [the deep darkness of] the shadow of death.
Rise up! Come be our help, And ransom us for the sake of Your steadfast love.
